title: Forward conversion never opens on unreleased main: spec still labelled 17.4.0 while main refuses 17.5.0 retirements, so artifacts built by the published 17.4.0 CLI are refused
body:
Ruled: 5865890672 · letter A · 2026-09-28T08:02Z

## Source

This surfaced on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#1964 (floor 1 of the cloud framework re-cut, objectstack-ai/cloud#2332 / PR objectstack-ai/cloud#2423) and is tracked under epic objectstack-ai/cloud#2440.

Maintainer ruling in the epic session, 2026-09-28 (verbatim): 「平台修转换 + HotCRM 先删 scale（推荐）」. The platform fixes the forward conversion. hotcrm only removes what no release can convert.

## What breaks

objectstack `main` (measured at `862b6ce8`) already refuses keys that the retirement ledger marks "removed in @objectstack/spec 17.5.0". But `packages/spec` on `main` still carries the version label `17.4.0`, and 17.5.x is not published (npm `latest` = 17.4.0).

`applyArtifactForwardConversions` (`packages/metadata-core/src/artifact-forward-conversion.ts` ~301, `resolveInstalledSpecVersion`) therefore reads runtime `17.4.0` == the artifact's authored floor `^17.4.0` and returns **authored-current**. The retired conversions are then not replayed, and `MetadataPlugin._parseAndRegisterArtifact` (`packages/metadata/src/plugin.ts` ~894) refuses the artifact.

Consequence: any artifact built by the **published** `@objectstack/cli` 17.4.0 that contains a dashboard chart cannot boot on a runtime that runs unreleased `main`. At 17.4.0, `chartConfig.type` is **required**, and `main` refuses it. Such a runtime is the EE composed boot through `OS_COMPOSED_ARTIFACT_URL`, as cloud does when it pins a framework SHA. No source spelling of `chartConfig` is legal on both versions short of deleting the block.

## Measured (hotcrm#1964 dev report, 2026-09-28)

Probe: the same `ObjectStackDefinitionSchema.parse(applyArtifactForwardConversions(...))` from objectstack `862b6ce` dist, run on hotcrm `main`'s artifact:

| runtime label | verdict | conversions applied | issues left |
|---|---|---|---|
| `17.4.0` (actual label on main) | authored-current | none | 63: 16 `chartConfig.type`, 9 `xAxis`, 9 `yAxis`, 23 `objects..scale`, 6 `pages..assignedProfiles` |
| forced `17.5.0` | converted-forward | `dashboard-widget-chart-config-structure-removed` ×34, `page-assigned-profiles-removed` ×6, `page-component-filter-record-to-rule-array` ×4 | only the 23 currency `scale` issues (no conversion exists; hotcrm is removing them) |

Direct EE boot of the same artifact on `main`: exit 1. With all three key families stripped: serves (HTTP 200).

## Direction (for triage and the owning lane)

Make the conversion window open for artifacts authored at the last published release whenever the runtime already enforces a later retirement. The dev named two shapes; picking one is the owning lane's design call:
- **Option a.** `main` carries a prerelease label (e.g. `17.5.0-next`) as soon as it contains a 17.5 retirement.
- **Option b.** The window compares the artifact's authored version against the **retirement's own version** instead of the package label.

## Acceptance

1. An artifact built by the published 17.4.0 CLI with dashboard charts and page `assignedProfiles` boots on `main`, and the conversion notices are logged.
2. Newly authored sources that use the retired keys are still refused loudly.
3. A regression test pins the "unreleased main, artifact at last release" case.
